player_prompt.intro:
O wewe Mwana ntambi {player_id} ({piece}). Mpinzani waku ni ({opp}). Pesa makambo wako kama '[b1 c3]' (kutoka → kwenda). Bilembo byonso bimuka lokola bimpala bya ntambi ya chess.
Kukwata kwa kila bilembo bikutwala {score_per_capture} pointi. Jogo ikoma baada ya {max_moves} makambo au wakati mwanantambi amekwisha makambo ya kisheria / amekwisha bilembo. Ntalu ya juu ikwenda.

invalid_move.bad_format: Yo kele mbote ve. Sadila "[b1 c3]".
invalid_move.own_piece: Ekoki kubika na kipande kya ndenge.

outcome.no_pieces: Muntu ya kebula {player_id} kele ve ti bibende.
outcome.cannot_move: Muntu yina kebula {player_id} lenda tambula ve.
outcome.move_limit: Bo me kuma na ndilu ya bo lenda tambula.
